content.p: [Assented to 25 June 1991]
The Parliament of Australia enacts:
1. This Act may be cited as the Social Security (Rewrite) Transition Act 1991.
2. This Act commences immediately after the Social Security Act 1991 commences.
3. The Social Security Act 1947 is repealed.

section.heading: Insertion of schedule of savings and transitional provisions into the Social Security Act 1991

content.p: 4. After Schedule 1 to the Social Security Act 1991, the Schedule set out in Schedule 1 to this Act is inserted.

section.heading: Other amendments of the Social Security Act 1991 of a transitional nature

content.p: 5. The Social Security Act 1991 is amended as set out in Schedule 2.
6. The Acts specified in Schedule 3 are amended as set out in that Schedule.

p.b: Saving of pensions, benefits and allowances

content.p: 3. (1) If a determination granting a claim for a pension, benefit or allowance under the 1947 Act is in force immediately before 1 July 1991, the determination has effect, from 1 July 1991, as if it were a determination under this Act granting a claim for the corresponding pension, benefit or allowance under this Act.
Note: for the statutory authority for the determination under the 1947 Act see subsection 168 (3) of that Act.

(2) If a determination directing the making of a payment of a pension, benefit or allowance under the 1947 Act is in force immediately before 1 July 1991, the determination has effect, from 1 July 1991, as if it were a determination under this Act directing the making of a payment of the corresponding pension, benefit or allowance under this Act.
Note: for the statutory authority for the determination under the 1947 Act see subsection 168 (3) of that Act.

(3) If a determination of the rate of a pension, benefit or allowance under the 1947 Act is in force immediately before 1 July 1991, the determination has effect, from 1 July 1991, as if it were a determination under this Act of the rate of the corresponding pension, benefit or allowance under this Act.
Note: for the statutory authority for the determination under the 1947 Act see subsections 168 (1) and (3) of that Act.
(4) This clause's principal effect is to allow the continued payment of pensions, benefits and allowances granted under the 1947 Act without the need for a new claim by the recipient.

content.p: 20. (1) If a pension was, immediately before 16 September 1975, payable to a person in Papua New Guinea because of section 14 of the Social Services Act (No. 2) 1973, the pension continues to be payable to the person as if the Papua New Guinea area formed part of Australia.

item.p: Subclause (1) only applies to the person while the person remains in the Papua New Guinea area.
